name: Jude Jazza
source:
A cold-blooded person who loves the despair and misfortunes of others.

Even before he joined the Crown, he ran a trading company and had many enemies.

A twisted man, he has a promise he wants to fulfill and a sullen heart...

Organisation: Crown
Fairy Tale Curse: Sleeping Beauty's the 13th Wizard

[Translated from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/villains/original/character/#jude]official website[/url]]
